implementation.avatar_format: UT99 vertex animation; existing VRM skeleton LOD code is separate
implementation.xr_policy: Physical distance from active XRCamera3D; local first-person and previews remain full detail. XR rendering performance not measured.
implementation.mesh_policy: Shared full / approximately 50% / approximately 25% triangle index meshes. Positions, original animated vertex IDs, skin UVs, IK weights, material and conservative animation/IK bounds are unchanged between tiers. Animation textures are shared and never resampled.
implementation.preparation: Generate once per decoded model/skin during library preparation, never in an avatar frame update. Inputs over 30000 corners retain full geometry. Rejected altered attributes also retain full geometry.
implementation.fallback: GPU original vertex animation continues every frame. Stop CPU head/arm solves after distance fade. Retire shader IK flags once. Fade held weapon presentation with IK; death and lost tracking disable IK immediately.
implementation.overrides: distance_ik_enabled and mesh_lod_enabled support independent comparisons; set_first_person, preview_mode and missing camera retain full detail.

limitations: Index-only simplification uses the reference shape; no all-frame geometric error bound is claimed. Magnified review images show loss of small face/limb details at the far tier; deployed only at small projected size.
Mesh transitions use hysteresis, without geomorphing. Vertex buffers and animation texture memory are not reduced; the optimization reduces submitted triangles and vertex shader work.

32-avatar timing is an isolated mono Vulkan render test, not an admission-limit result for the jungle map, combat, networking or actual stereo XR. Both baseline and optimized cases use the new full-detail indexed mesh and shader; repeated cases show CPU/GPU timing variation.
review: Screenshots of run, crouch, jump and early death compare full/medium/far rows at the same magnified size; these intentionally expose far-detail loss. Layout screenshots come from measured benchmark cases.
